events.detail: Noticed alerts for large packages never ordered

snippet: A social media user was told their account had been mass-reported and was directed to a Discord support contact. They gave the scammer access to their account, which was then lost, and are asking about other consequences.

events.detail: emails confirmed a lookup site account and payment using the victim's email
text message with a lookup link sent to the victim's phone
locked cards and cancelled the subscription to check for charges

snippet: A person received emails about an account and payment on a lookup site they never used, plus a text with a link. They locked their cards and cancelled the subscription, and no charge appeared.

events.detail: another teen met online exchanged numbers and inappropriate images
voicemail from a caller claiming to be the other teen's parent
worried about legal trouble and asking whether to respond

snippet: A minor exchanged images with another teen met online and then received a voicemail from a caller claiming to be that teen's parent. The minor is frightened about legal risk and is asking whether to respond.

events.detail: QR code in a video promised a Tesla bitcoin giveaway
closed the page after seeing a bitcoin payment request

snippet: A person scanned a QR code promising a Tesla bitcoin giveaway and was taken to a page asking for cryptocurrency. They closed it without sending money and are worried about malware.

events.detail: buyer comment directed seller to a sister for pickup
asked the seller to move conversation to text messages
replies contained inconsistencies and a pickup at an unclear time

snippet: A seller listed a pasta machine and was contacted by a buyer's supposed sister, who asked for pickup details and offered a story about health problems. The seller suspects a scam and is asking for a second opinion.

events.detail: artist sent an invoice from an unknown company instead of PayPal
noticed misspelling and a traced AI image used as the example

snippet: A customer commissioned an artwork but received an invoice from an unknown company, and the sample appeared to be a traced AI image. The customer wants to know whether the invoice can be cancelled and how to spot this in future.

events.detail: email posing as a job board about a part-time mystery shopper gig
mailed a $2,750 cashier's check with instructions to buy gift cards
researched the mailing and sender details and found the scheme
did not deposit the check or buy any gift cards

snippet: A person received a $2,750 cashier's check for a supposed secret shopper assignment that required buying gift cards. They recognised the fake check scheme and did not deposit it or send any codes.

events.detail: unexpected check arrived with a phone number to call
suspects a phishing attempt to get account details

snippet: A person received a check they cannot connect to any transaction, along with a number to call. They are worried it is a phishing attempt to access their bank account and are asking for advice.

events.detail: found unfamiliar charges on a prepaid card and balance dropped
about $112 lost from the prepaid card after unauthorised charges

snippet: A person found about five unauthorised charges on a prepaid card, many from payment platform vendors used by someone else in the household. The balance dropped by about $112, and the person is asking how the card was linked.

events.detail: text offered a talent pool job paying $6,100 monthly
required a deposit through a payment app to unlock final premium tasks
suspects a scam but completed earlier app-boosting tasks

snippet: A person was offered a high-paying job by text and completed app-boosting tasks on a website. The final step required a payment app deposit, which they suspect is a scam.

events.detail: woman at a gas station asked for $20 for gas
declined to give money and left

snippet: A person was approached at a gas station by a stranger who asked for $20 for gas after making unusual eye contact. The person declined and is asking what the stranger might have been doing.

events.detail: unsolicited call offering at-home visits to schedule
caller claimed to be from the person's healthcare provider
declined the visits and suspected a spoofed call

snippet: A person received a call from someone claiming to be from their healthcare provider and pressing for at-home visits they did not need. They declined, hung up, and are asking whether the call was spoofed.

events.detail: unsolicited email claiming to have viewed profile and asking to connect
received repeated follow-ups and suspects a common template

snippet: A person received an unsolicited networking email followed by two reminders. They suspect the message is a template used on many people.

events.detail: stranger at the door asked about a missing woman and showed photos
suspected a ruse to get a call or case the home
police agreed to send an officer to check the area

snippet: A woman answered her door to a stranger who asked about a missing woman and left a contact card. She reported it to the police and is worried it was a ruse to get her to call or to case the home.

events.detail: repeated calls and voicemails claiming to have an email from the mother
child suspects the email was spoofed or a scam

snippet: A retired parent has received repeated calls from a stranger claiming to have an email from her and offering to give her a credit card number. Her child is unsure whether the email was spoofed or whether this is a scam.

events.detail: caller asked for the victim by name at work, claiming a sheriff's investigation
claimed to be a county sheriff's office investigator
threatened arrest and a warrant and demanded legal name
asked coworkers and requested a badge number, caller became angry
local sheriff's office said the caller was running a scam

snippet: A tattoo artist received a call from someone claiming to be a sheriff's investigator who threatened arrest and asked for personal details. The local sheriff's office confirmed it was a scam, and the person lost no money.

events.detail: call from someone claiming to be a bank fraud research team
claimed a $7,435 card purchase and pressed for a police report
called the number back and reached a voicemail

snippet: A person received a call from someone claiming to be a bank's fraud team about a large attempted purchase, and was pressed to speak with a police investigator. The person called back, reached only a voicemail, and did not share any details.

events.detail: email impersonating a computer brand's support sent a link
clicked link and signed up using a Google account
contacted the brand, which said the email was not theirs

snippet: A person clicked a link in an email impersonating a computer brand and signed up with their Google account. The brand said the email was not theirs, and the person is worried about the risk.

events.detail: about fifteen spam calls a day about Medicare and debt offers

snippet: A person's work phone number receives around fifteen spam calls a day, mainly about Medicare and debt consolidation. The person is asking whether the calls will ever stop.

events.detail: email claims a trust benefit is ready and requests a virtual meeting
asks whether it is a scam given the long delay in notice

snippet: A person received an email claiming a trust benefit was being released after a family member's death and asking for a meeting. They are asking whether it is a scam, given the notice came a year later.

events.detail: buyer asked to pay an art commission through a money transfer app
told to send $300 more before the account could be used
unsure whether the second request is real and has not refunded

snippet: An artist was asked by a buyer to pay for a commission through a money transfer app, then was told to refund $300 before the account could be used. The artist has not sent the money and suspects a scam.

events.detail: call claiming an unpaid medical debt of about $1,500
claimed to be a medical group and quoted the spouse's SSN
callback line kept ringing without anyone answering

snippet: A person's spouse received a call from a collector claiming an unpaid medical debt of about $1,500 and quoting her SSN. The household has received no prior letters and is worried about the call.

events.detail: seller listed a console below average price
noticed refusal of cash and shipping before payment
blocked and ignored the seller

snippet: A buyer contacted a seller offering a console at a low price who refused cash and wanted payment through transfer apps. The buyer found the behaviour suspicious, blocked the seller, and did not pay.

events.detail: conference promoted by an influencer offered fully funded seats
noticed no named organizer and requests for national ID

snippet: A person found a conference offering funded seats for a small fee, with no named organizer and requests for national ID. They are asking others whether the event is a scam.
